records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/chaski/README.md#what-it-does
records.summary: Chaski reacts to graph changes and scheduled deadlines using SELECT focus sets; changes to those sets drive transition handling.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/chaski/README.md#incremental-verdict-adapters
records.summary: Incremental adapters declare subscriptions and route changed subjects to bounded durable key queues; UNKNOWN preserves earlier verdicts rather than asserting recovery.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/chaski/README.md#development
records.summary: The distribution chaski-reactor exposes chaski, chaski-event and chaski-once commands. Its offline canary is distinct from live consumer state.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/chaski/README.md#incremental-verdict-adapters
records.summary: Version-1 JSON adapter requests support discovery, routing and scoped item evaluation; emitter configuration is YAML and durable offsets resume committed work.

properties.publicName: Emitter YAML and version-1 adapter JSON

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/chaski/README.md#authenticated-external-event-sources
records.summary: The local external-event CLI queues authenticated-source events into the existing outbox. Authentication belongs to the caller; this CLI does not expose a network listener.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/chaski/README.md#design-constraints
records.summary: The documented design requires public graph APIs, output liveness, UNKNOWN distinct from all-clear, transition-only writes and existing Prometheus/Alertmanager emission.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/chaski/README.md
records.summary: Read the reactor overview and documented boundaries before configuring event or schedule rules.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/chaski/README.md#design-constraints
records.summary: Preserve UNKNOWN and output-liveness boundaries when changing adapters or receivers.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/chaski/README.md#development
records.summary: Run the locked tests and offline canary before adopting a release; source smoke is not live receiver acceptance.
